summary.question: Monitoring shows the input and output power reported by oms.S10-S02.amp6 unchanged since about t=600 s while neighbouring readings vary. What is the cause?

cause_and_place.basis: the six leading hypotheses of the final ledger

llm.report:
The system could not decide among five candidates: WSS attenuation drift at oms.S17-S24|4; WSS attenuation drift at oms.S24-S18|4; instrument misreporting at inst.oms.S10-S02.amp6.input_power; stale telemetry at that instrument; or none of these. This candidate set has probability 0.94, and the system indicates the cause was probably not omitted from consideration.

It is 0.784 sure the fault mode is WSS_ATTEN_DRIFT and 0.702 sure the location is oms.S17-S24|4. The leading combined cause and location has probability 0.702.

Runners-up were: WSS_ATTEN_DRIFT@oms.S17-S24|4 (0.702); WSS_ATTEN_DRIFT@oms.S24-S18|4 (0.082); INSTRUMENT_MISREPORT@inst.oms.S10-S02.amp6.input_power (0.054); TELEMETRY_STALE@inst.oms.S10-S02.amp6.input_power (0.054); none of these (0.048); and WSS_FILTER_SHIFT@oms.S24-S18|4 (0.041).

No checks, engineering effort, or site visits were recorded, so the available evidence did not settle the cause.
